content.title: Trump announces naval blockade of Iran after Islamabad talks yield no deal - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Susannah George, Natalie Allison and Shaiq HussainISLAMABAD, Pakistan — After marathon overnight talks between the United States and Iran failed to yield a deal on U.S. terms, President Donald Trump on Sunday announced the imposition of a naval blockade on Iran — a move that could derail a tenuous two-week ceasefire reached just five days ago.What readers are sayingThe comments express strong criticism of President Trump's handling of the US-Iran negotiations, highlighting perceived incompetence and lack of diplomatic skill.
